plain_english_summary: Not itself an app change — a routine check found that the main branch was still pointing at a dead server address two months after that had already been fixed elsewhere, so this merges the fix into main.
correct_agent_response: The underlying fix is code complete and confirmed: the two files the commit names as previously broken (auth.ts, apiClient.ts) are clean of the dead server address after this merge. Flagged, not yet safe to publish as-is: the commit's own verification claim overstates its scope — it says the dead address 'no longer appears in main's src/api/' at all, but it still appears twice in a third file (pinnedFetch.ts), inside a code comment documenting certificate-pinning setup, not as a live URL. The substance is fine, but the claim as literally written is false. A developer should either narrow the claim to the two files actually checked, or explain why the comment references are expected and harmless, before this status is shown publicly.
